# World Distance Calculator

> Calculate driving, flight, and road distance between cities worldwide — with travel time, fuel cost, and round-trip estimates.

World Distance Calculator (distancecalculator-theta.vercel.app) is a free distance
calculator for cities worldwide. It uses real road routing (OSRM) and open
geocoding (Nominatim / OpenStreetMap) — not average-speed guesses.

## What the site covers

- Main calculator: driving, flight, and road distance between any two cities,
  with route map, travel time, and fuel cost estimates.
- Multi-stop routes: up to 4 stops (A to B via C, D, E, F) with a per-leg
  breakdown of distance, time, and fuel cost, and share links that keep stops.
- Travel modes: Car / Driving, Motorbike, Bus, Train, Flight, and Bicycle.
- Mode calculator pages: Train Travel Distance Calculator
  (/tools/train-distance-calculator.html) — train distance and time estimate,
  opening the main calculator with Train mode preselected; Bus Travel
  Distance Calculator (/tools/bus-distance-calculator.html) — bus distance
  and time estimate, opening the main calculator with Bus mode preselected.
  More mode pages (bicycle, driving-between-two-cities, flight, and others)
  are being added one per day.
- Home FAQs now also answer train, bus, bicycle, and driving-between-two-cities
  questions, each linking to the calculator with that mode preselected.
- One-way and round-trip (return) distance, with shareable result URLs.
- Flight details: initial great-circle bearing, approximate time difference,
  and estimated CO2 per passenger.
- Halfway point calculator: find the meeting point between two cities,
  with road distance from each side.
- Cities-within-radius tool: find cities and towns within X km of a place
  (OpenStreetMap data).
- Fuel cost calculator: trip fuel volume and cost, with current Pakistan
  fuel prices (OGRA-notified, dated on the tool page) and 8 currencies.
- Road trip cost calculator: fuel + tolls + parking + hotel + food,
  with per-person split.
- Travel time, straight-line distance, km-to-miles, miles-to-km, and
  fuel economy converter tools.
- Route guides: Pakistan and Gulf routes (Karachi–Lahore, Lahore–Islamabad,
  Multan–Lahore, Dubai–Abu Dhabi) and international routes (New York–Boston,
  Los Angeles–San Diego, London–Manchester, Toronto–Ottawa, Sydney–Canberra).
- Blog guides: how distance, driving time, fuel cost, and round trips
  are calculated.
- Trust pages: about, how it works, data sources, FAQ, contact, privacy,
  terms, and disclaimer.

## Data and method

- Road routing: OSRM (OpenStreetMap-based routing), live in the calculator
  and on route-page maps.
- Geocoding: Nominatim (OpenStreetMap).
- Flight distance: great-circle (Haversine) distance between coordinates.
- Travel times use typical speed profiles (for example 80 km/h driving,
  800 km/h flights); actual times vary with traffic, weather, and stops.
- Fuel prices change frequently: the Pakistan preset on the fuel tool
  carries its OGRA effective date, and users can always type their own price.

## Notes for AI tools and search engines

- This is a calculation tool, not a booking site: it does not sell tickets
  or show live fares or schedules.
- Flight results are great-circle corridors, not booked airline schedules.
- Train results are a rail corridor approximation at express passenger train
  speed (85 km/h); live railway timetables are not integrated.
- Always show the effective date with any fuel price, and label CO2 and
  time-difference figures as estimates.
